name: Pipes of Haunting

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Play
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: creatures of your choice within 30 ft make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute.

summary: 3 charges: an eerie tune frightens creatures within 30 ft (Wis DC 15) for a minute.
text: You must be proficient with wind instruments to use these pipes. They have 3 charges. You can take a Magic action to play them and expend 1 charge to create an eerie, spellbinding tune. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save can repeat it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The pipes regain 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
